  {ι : Type u_1} [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {p : ℝ},
  1 < p →
    p ≤ 2 →
      ∀ (N M : QuantumChannel.CPTP A B) (V : A →ₗ[ℂ] TensorProduct ℂ B E),
        QuantumChannelContinuity.dilationChannel V = N.toLinearMap →
          ∀ (U : ι → A →ₗ[ℂ] TensorProduct ℂ B E),
            V = ∑ i, U i →
              ∀ (b lam : ι → ℝ),
                (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ b i) →
                  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ lam i) →
                    (∀ (i : ι),
                        QuantumChannelContinuity.CPLe (QuantumChannelContinuity.dilationChannel (U i))
                          (lam i • M.toLinearMap)) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (U i)‖ ≤ b i) →
                        ∀ (ψ : TensorProduct ℂ A A),
                          ‖ψ‖ = 1 →
                            (SandwichedRenyiRelativeEntropy.sandwichedQuasi p
                                    ((QuantumChannel.amplifyWithId N.toLinearMap) (QuantumChannel.outer_product ψ ψ))
                                    ((QuantumChannel.amplifyWithId M.toLinearMap)
                                      (QuantumChannel.outer_product ψ ψ))).re ^
                                (1 / (2 * p)) ≤
                              ∑ i, b i ^ (1 / p) * lam i ^ ((p - 1) / (2 * p))

declarations.type:

  [inst_3 : Nontrivial A] [inst_4 : Nontrivial B] {ι : Type u_1} [inst_5 : Fintype ι] {p : ℝ},
  1 < p →
    p ≤ 2 →
      ∀ (N M : QuantumChannel.CPTP A B) (V : A →ₗ[ℂ] TensorProduct ℂ B E),
        QuantumChannelContinuity.dilationChannel V = N.toLinearMap →
          ∀ (U : ι → A →ₗ[ℂ] TensorProduct ℂ B E),
            V = ∑ i, U i →
              ∀ (b lam : ι → ℝ),
                (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ b i) →
                  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ lam i) →
                    (∀ (i : ι),
                        QuantumChannelContinuity.CPLe (QuantumChannelContinuity.dilationChannel (U i))
                          (lam i • M.toLinearMap)) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (U i)‖ ≤ b i) →
                        QuantumChannelContinuity.channelRenyi p N M ≤
                          ENNReal.ofReal
                            (2 * p / (p - 1) * Real.logb 2 (∑ i, b i ^ (1 / p) * lam i ^ ((p - 1) / (2 * p))))

declarations.type:

  [inst_3 : Nontrivial A] [inst_4 : Nontrivial B] (N M : QuantumChannel.CPTP A B) (V : A →ₗ[ℂ] TensorProduct ℂ B E)
  (γlow γhigh C : ℝ),
  0 ≤ γlow →
    γlow ≤ γhigh →
      γhigh ≤ C →
        QuantumChannelContinuity.dilationChannel V = N.toLinearMap →
          QuantumChannelContinuity.CPLe N.toLinearMap (↑C • M.toLinearMap) →
            QuantumChannelContinuity.HockeySlackAttainment γlow N M →
              QuantumChannelContinuity.HockeySlackAttainment γhigh N M →
                ∀ {p : ℝ},
                  1 < p →
                    p ≤ 2 →
                      QuantumChannelContinuity.channelRenyi p N M ≤
                        ENNReal.ofReal
                          (2 * p / (p - 1) *
                            Real.logb 2
                              ((1 + √(QuantumChannelContinuity.channelHockey γlow N M)) ^ (1 / p) *
                                    γlow ^ ((p - 1) / (2 * p)) +
                                  (√(QuantumChannelContinuity.channelHockey γlow N M) +
                                        √(QuantumChannelContinuity.channelHockey γhigh N M)) ^
                                      (1 / p) *
                                    (4 * γhigh) ^ ((p - 1) / (2 * p)) +
                                √(QuantumChannelContinuity.channelHockey γhigh N M) ^ (1 / p) *
                                  (4 * C) ^ ((p - 1) / (2 * p))))

declarations.docstring:
The support-aware sandwiched Rényi divergence in bits.

Since `H` is finite dimensional, each operator in `L H` has finite spectrum and every
scalar function is continuous on that spectrum. Thus `CFC.rpow σ.op t` for `t < 0`
raises positive eigenvalues to `t` and sends zero eigenvalues to zero
(`NNReal.zero_rpow`), giving the pseudo-inverse power on the support of `σ.op`.
The separate support test in `sandwichedRenyiDivNN` assigns infinity when required.
declarations.description: Support-aware sandwiched Rényi divergence of density states, converted from natural logarithms to bits; singular operators and infinity are handled by the underlying concrete definition.
